promise: End inflation within the first year of his second term
description: In an August 2024 economic address Trump pledged to use 'every tool' to defeat inflation within the first year of a second term. US CPI inflation remained positive at roughly 2.5-3% through 2025, and prices never fell.
evidence: Trump later said lowering prices was 'hard' and 'can't guarantee anything'

promise: Energy prices will come down 50% or more within a year
description: Trump promised during his inauguration week that 'drill, baby, drill' policies would halve energy prices within 12 months. Gasoline and electricity prices did not fall by half; regular gas stayed around $3.10-3.30/gal and electricity costs rose, making the 50% target widely treated as a failed pledge.
evidence: US average gas prices stayed near $3/gal through 2025-2026, far from a 50% cut
AP/PolitiFact fact-checked the 50% energy claim as lacking evidence in early 2025

role: United Nations member states ratifying the BBNJ Agreement
promise: Bring the High Seas Treaty into force after 60 ratifications
description: The Agreement under UNCLOS on the conservation and sustainable use of marine biological diversity of areas beyond national jurisdiction (BBNJ) was adopted in June 2023 after nearly two decades of negotiations. The 60th ratification was deposited in September 2025, triggering entry into force 120 days later on 17 January 2026; more than 80 countries had ratified by early 2026.
evidence: Treaty entered into force on 17 January 2026
Over 80 ratifications by January 2026, with first Conference of the Parties expected in 2026

promise: Initiate talks on a new Constitution in January 2026
description: Dissanayake told the Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi that his government would begin talks on a promised new Constitution in January 2026. A multisectoral dialogue on the new constitution was held in January 2026, and the government continued to accelerate the reform process, though the constitution had not been finalised by mid-2026.
evidence: Multisectoral dialogue on a new constitution held January 2026
Constitutional reform process ongoing as of July 2026
